products_head.title: Practical tools, ready to use
products_head.text: From cloud management and store operations to marketing automation, choose tools that fit your workflow. Ask about trials for ready-to-use products, or discuss scope and pricing for equipment integration and custom solutions.

products.name: Cloud Attendance Calendar
products.text: Clock-ins, leave, overtime and assigned tasks in one calendar. Includes GPS or workplace-network clock-in, overtime estimates and support for seven languages.
products.detail: Employees clock in from their phones, while leave, overtime and assigned tasks appear in a shared calendar. Managers can see who is working and review attendance and overtime calculations at month-end.
products.features:
Mobile clock-in | Use GPS or the workplace network without buying a clock-in terminal
Online requests | Employees submit leave and overtime requests on their phones; approved requests appear in the calendar
Overtime estimates | Calculate weekday and rest-day overtime using Taiwan labor rules
Assigned tasks | See who is responsible for each task and when it is due
Seven languages | Supports Chinese, English, Vietnamese, Indonesian, Thai, Japanese and more
App-like access | Add the website to your phone's home screen without installing a separate app
products.fit:
Shops and factories with shifts, field staff or part-time employees
Teams with staff who speak different languages
Businesses replacing paper attendance sheets and leave forms

products.name: Cloud Inventory Management
products.text: Manage purchasing, sales, stocktaking and inventory in one place. Track costs and gross profit by product and sales channel.
products.detail: Bring purchasing, sales, stocktaking and inventory into one system. Calculate costs and gross profit for each transaction, then compare performance across products and sales channels.
products.features:
Multiple sales channels | Keep Shopee, your website and physical-store records separate or review them together
Automatic stock updates | Purchases and sales update inventory without daily spreadsheet edits
Costs and gross profit | See how much each product and channel earns
Stocktaking | Adjust inventory using actual stock counts
Export reports | Export to Excel for reconciliation and accounting
products.fit:
Shopee and other online sellers
Small businesses with both an online shop and a physical store
Teams struggling to reconcile spreadsheet inventory

products.text: Explore six research lists and compare US companies by valuation, financial quality, growth and momentum. Sector filters and stock details help narrow your research.

products.detail: Spend less time looking up financial figures one stock at a time. The radar organizes price and fundamental data into six lists, with industry-relative scores for valuation, quality, growth and momentum. Filter the lists, then open a stock page to review its selection reasons, financial metrics and one-year price history.
products.features:
Six research lists | Explore low-P/E opportunities, composite scores, quality pullbacks, analyst sentiment, stable dividends and momentum
Industry-relative scores | Compare valuation, financial quality, growth and momentum within the same sector, alongside a composite score
Sector and market-cap filters | Narrow your research by sector and minimum market capitalization
Stock details and selection reasons | Review P/E, cash flow, revenue growth, analyst data and why a stock appears on a list
Price history and performance | View one-year trends, 52-week ranges and returns over several periods
Scheduled post-market updates | Run daily updates while the service is active, or start an update manually and check the data timestamp

People building a US stock research list using consistent criteria
Researchers comparing valuation and financial quality within an industry
People who want fundamentals, price trends and selection reasons in one place
products.notice: Data is not real-time. Completeness and update times depend on the data sources. Scores and lists are research and screening tools, not investment advice, and do not guarantee returns.

products.name: Shopee Auto Bump
products.text: Choose products and their order in your desktop browser, then automate product bumping. Scheduling, manual runs and activity logs reduce repetitive Seller Centre tasks.
products.detail: Let a browser extension handle repeated product-bumping tasks. Sign in to Shopee Seller Centre, select your products, arrange their order and turn on automation. The extension schedules runs based on available slots and previous bump times, with the next run, daily totals and activity logs visible at a glance.
products.features:
Product selection and ordering | Search for products, select them and adjust their order
Rotation and slot filling | Work through the selected list and rotate products when it exceeds the batch size
Scheduling and wait settings | Track bump times and set intervals for the next run
Manual controls | Run once to check the result, or use the start/pause switch
Status and activity logs | Review the next run, last run, daily totals and success or error messages
License activation and trial | Activate with a license key and ask about a three-day free trial; contact us for device-binding changes
products.fit:
Shopee sellers who regularly bump products
Stores that want to rotate a larger product list in a set order
Users who can keep their computer awake, browser open and Seller Centre signed in
products.notice: Requires desktop Chrome or Edge, extension installation and a computer that stays awake with the browser open. This is not an official Shopee service. Automated actions may lead to warnings or account restrictions; assess the risks and follow platform rules. Search rankings and sales are not guaranteed.

products.name: Factory Pre-production Management System
products.text: Connect pre-production checklists, barcode scanning, motion stages and inkjet printing in one system, with preparation checks and production records.
products.detail: A chemical-materials factory needed to prepare multiple molds and checklists before production, alongside motion stages, inkjet printers and barcode scanners on the shop floor. We brought manual checks, equipment control and record keeping into one system.
products.features:
Preparation checklists｜Create pre-production checklists so operators can check molds, quantities and handling notes in order.
Batch-change comparison｜Compare the current checklist with the previous batch and highlight additions, removals and changes to reduce repeated checking.
Barcode lookup｜Retrieve product information by scanning a barcode, reducing manual searches and data-entry errors.
Production history｜Keep records of each production run so managers can trace issues and look up historical data.
products.fit:
Factories with preparation and verification workflows
Shop floors integrating motion stages, inkjet printers or barcode scanners
Managers who need production records and issue tracing

solution_sections.title: Equipment and platform integration
items: Control the motion stage and inkjet printer together and adjust their timing to keep product positioning consistent.
Determine product orientation and print content automatically to reduce errors from repeated manual typing.
Report equipment status on screen so supervisors can monitor startup, positioning and faults.

solution_sections.title: Benefits
items: Reduce time spent explaining preparation checklists and repeating the same instructions.
Reduce manual entry and transcription errors, including incorrect print content and missed steps.
Support retries and recovery when equipment faults occur, helping operators resolve issues more efficiently.

products.name: Facebook Lead Assignment and Automated Comment and Message Replies
products.text: Automate Facebook comment and Messenger replies, collect Facebook and Instagram ad leads, assign sales staff and send LINE notifications for follow-up.
products.detail: Manage Facebook Page comments, Messenger conversations and Facebook or Instagram ad forms in one place. When customers post a configured keyword or send a message, the system can reply according to your rules or use private messages to guide them through sharing their contact details. New leads are checked for duplicates, assigned to sales staff in rotation and announced through LINE notifications. Managers can see who owns each lead and how follow-up is progressing, with records also synchronized to Google Sheets. This reduces manual replies, copying and pasting, and missed inquiries.
products.features:
Facebook comment replies｜Reply to Facebook Page-post comments according to configured rules and use specified keywords to guide follow-up interactions.
Messenger conversations｜Support automated Messenger replies and conversation flows, including private messages after comments and prompts for contact details.
Facebook and Instagram ad forms｜Collect Facebook or Instagram ad-form submissions automatically and record their Page, form and advertising campaign.
Duplicate checks and assignment｜Detect duplicate entries, exclude leads that should not be contacted and distribute the remaining leads to sales staff in rotation.
Central administration｜Manage advertising campaigns, sales staff, lead sources, LINE notifications and Google Sheets synchronization in one place.
Progress and notifications｜Check follow-up progress and notification records, with records and resend options to help resolve notification or synchronization issues.
Multiple Pages and campaigns｜Manage several Pages, forms and campaigns together so customer records from different sources stay in one place.
Flexible integrations｜Add LINE automated replies, email notifications, website forms or other system connections as the team needs them.
products.fit:
Teams collecting customer leads through Facebook and Instagram ads
Businesses automating Page comments and Messenger replies
Managers assigning leads and tracking sales follow-up

solution_sections.title: Equipment and platform integration
items: Connect Facebook and Instagram ad forms to receive customer details automatically.
Connect Page comments and Messenger private messages for rule-based replies.
Send individual or group LINE notifications to alert sales staff about new leads.
Synchronize customer leads to Google Sheets for shared access and reporting.
Connect existing customer-management or business-management systems as needed.

solution_sections.title: Benefits
items: Assign new leads and notify sales staff without waiting for someone to forward them manually.
Use rule-based replies to help respond to customer comments and private messages.
Reduce downloading, copying and pasting, as well as missed leads and scattered records.
Keep lead, notification and synchronization records so problems are easier to trace.
Give managers a view of ownership and progress, while helping sales staff see whom to contact next.
Start with lead collection and assignment, then add functions as the team needs them.

products.name: Central Warehouse and POS Integration for a Restaurant Chain
products.text: Connect store replenishment, central consolidation, dispatch, receiving and inventory, with POS, loyalty and reporting planned around your needs.
products.detail: We helped a grilled-food restaurant chain plan an integrated headquarters platform. The project replaces handwritten store replenishment orders, photos sent through LINE and manual consolidation with online requests, central aggregation, dispatch, receiving and inventory records. The scope also plans a store POS interface, receipt-printer and cash-drawer integration, loyalty points, attendance scheduling and an owner dashboard, giving headquarters a central view of stores and a repeatable foundation for expansion.
products.features:
Roles and permissions｜Define accounts and role permissions for owners, headquarters, warehouse staff, store managers and employees.
Online replenishment｜Let stores submit replenishment orders online instead of sending photos of handwritten orders through LINE, reducing omissions, misreading and manual consolidation.
Central demand consolidation｜Aggregate store demand centrally by store and item to support preparation and dispatch.
Dispatch, receiving and stock｜Record central dispatch, store receipt confirmation and discrepancy reports, with a history of shipments, receipts and stock movements.
Store POS planning｜Plan a store POS interface for product selection, orders, additions, checkout, daily closing, printing and cash-drawer control.
Local-first synchronization｜Use a local-first POS design with SQLite storing orders and transactions during service and synchronizing to headquarters in the background.
Operations extensions｜Reserve extension modules for POS sales synchronization, loyalty points, coupons, attendance scheduling, opening and closing checklists, and store task assignments.
Owner dashboard｜Provide an owner dashboard and reports covering replenishment, dispatch, receiving, stock, waste, sales and membership data.
products.fit:
Restaurant brands with multiple stores and central preparation
Teams systematizing replenishment, dispatch and receiving
Businesses planning staged POS, loyalty and operations integration

solution_sections.title: Equipment and platform integration
items: The store POS client can be built with Electron and Node.js for local device control and offline storage.
Recommend thermal printers supporting ESC/POS commands for kitchen tickets, counter tickets and customer receipts.
Trigger electronic cash drawers through the thermal printer's drawer port and record the time, operator and reason for opening.
Synchronize products, orders, replenishment requests, receiving and daily closing between the cloud headquarters backend and store POS clients through REST APIs.
Integrate LINE Login, LIFF or LINE Messaging API as entry points for loyalty, attendance, notifications and marketing.
Evaluate vendor APIs, read-only database access, automated exports or a custom POS according to the capabilities offered by the POS provider.

solution_sections.title: Benefits
items: Systematize store replenishment to reduce handwriting, photos, missed LINE messages and manual consolidation.
Give the central warehouse visibility into store demand and improve preparation, dispatch and receiving follow-up.
Keep stock-movement records to trace issues and analyze shortages and waste.
Once POS and backend data are integrated, sales records can support reports, loyalty points, replenishment suggestions and operations decisions.
Support repeat visits and brand engagement through LINE loyalty points, coupons and messaging.
Reduce communication work for store managers and headquarters through attendance scheduling, opening and closing checklists, and store task assignments.
Adopt replenishment and warehouse workflows first, then extend the modular platform with POS, loyalty, attendance and replenishment planning.

faq.q: Does a lower price mean lower quality?
faq.a: Savings come from our development process. AI handles repetitive coding tasks, while we focus on requirements, testing and quality checks before delivery.
We reuse proven components from our existing products and use AI-assisted development to get a working version ready sooner.

faq.q: Can I request changes after launch?
faq.a: Ongoing adjustments are available through a maintenance plan. Contact us on LINE for minor changes; larger features are quoted for your approval first.
Cloud products use servers with encrypted connections, separate company data and regular backups. Custom projects can also run on your own server or cloud account.

faq.q: Can I try a product first?
faq.a: Yes. Paid products offer a free trial, and both stock radars are free to use. For custom projects, we can show a demonstration after the initial discussion.
